cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm leading tomorrow's hike. Ridge or river on your copy? I'm making sure we're all working from my latest plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ridge, since the river flooded. You asked me that yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, the update stuck. Now tell me our meeting point and I'll check that too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've forgotten it. I'll brief everyone, but I'm not doing the work while you call yourself leader.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Co-leaders, then. That was the next phase. Start your briefing with where we're meeting; I'll repeat it to everyone so they know we're united.
